Fix: a CLI or hook export that writes the transcript to a file and prints a summary; use kinds ["result"] first and get_event for single uuids.
3. Gates run by the root, repeated: mise run verify failed at 17:12:54 and 17:20:34 (mise absent); bun test, check, lint and fmt re-run at 17:13:02, 17:13:15, 17:14:14, 17:15:24, 17:21:02 (bun test about 55 s); mise run verify again at 17:33:05 and 17:37:55 [verified]. Fix: Worker.validation runs the gates once on the head; the container gets mise via its setup script; session-start warns when a toolchain is missing.
4. Skill built, then rejected: the brief offered a skill only conditionally ("If the agent setting is ignored… add a skill"). The root made it a requirement (TaskCreate 17:11:02, SendMessage 17:17:01), ran a worker, Reviewer.artifact (17:32:38) and gates. The user wrote "root shouldn't be a skill" (17:37:03). Removed 17:37:39, after dist/skills/root/SKILL.md had been committed (17:34:55). About 25 min and one commit of churn [verified]. Fix: Intent creation records conditional brief text as an open AskUserQuestion, not a requirement.

Fix: commit the writer's diff locally when it reports (holyagent.md line 65), or exempt the WIP of Running Assignments in the hook.
6. Same hook diff reviewed twice: Reviewer.code on the uncommitted diff (17:18:19) and the /code-review skill in the main thread (17:18:28) [verified]. Fix: one reviewer per head.
7. Wrong-premise question: at 18:19:27 AskUserQuestion said the plugin came through the user's organization and asked for admin changes. The user replied at 18:37:21 that it is a personal account; the root conceded at 18:37:32 [verified]. About 18 min and one wasted round trip. Fix: check account type and the synced meta before asking.
8. Safety-net check-in: "Re-check PR #27 CI", created 17:40:32 with a 50 min delay while PR events were already subscribed; deleted 18:20:44 [verified]. Conflicts with holyagent.md line 27 (no polling).
9. Container restart: 9 min gap 17:22:21 to 17:31:24; specialists finished in the gap were recorded late (17:31:54) [gap verified; cause inference].
